name: Greenacres
dining_districts: the Lake Worth Road restaurant corridor
intro: Greenacres runs long and busy along Lake Worth Road — one of central county's densest restaurant corridors, where Latin American kitchens, family diners, pizzerias, and banquet caterers share plazas with the everyday businesses of a working city. Senior communities on the city's west side add institutional dining volume that runs on a fixed calendar.

Corridor kitchens get the flexible account: split cases, no minimums, staples plus the Latin produce list their menus draw on. Facility kitchens get scheduled case programs that hold specs across a menu cycle. Both ride the central Palm Beach leg out of Pompano Beach, about forty-five minutes door to door, every day of the week.
route_note: About 45 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse — Lake Worth Road corridor stops run daily on the central Palm Beach leg.

faqs_unique.q: Do you deliver along the Lake Worth Road corridor in Greenacres?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. The corridor's plazas are daily stops, with timing set to each kitchen's receiving window.

faqs_unique.q: Can senior community kitchens in Greenacres get scheduled programs?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Facility dining services run consistent case programs with reliable windows and menu-cycle planning.

cta_text: Tell us your corridor kitchen's staples or your facility's menu cycle — we will set a Greenacres produce program that fits.
